expectations.text: Reports a structural fact instead of a raw post count wherever no defensible divisor exists.
expectations.evidence: Wherever normalization isn't possible, the transcript substitutes structural facts for count comparisons: "Beacontree is 8 years old with 5 dedicated people; Windlass is 2 years old with 1 generalist"; the Content read states "Structural difference, not volume difference... The transferable fact for the CEO conversation isn't 'they publish more,' it's 'they have 4 more people whose job is to produce this.'" The scorecard carries structural rows (company age 2 vs 8, employees 19 vs ~350, DevRel headcount 1 vs 5) and refuses to fabricate the cells that can't be derived, marking format mix, everg
